ctaHeading: Ready to transform your garden in Caroline Springs?
aboutText: Caroline Springs Gardening has been serving the Caroline Springs community for over 15 years. We specialise in creating and maintaining beautiful gardens tailored to the local climate. Our team of experienced gardeners ensures every project is completed to the highest standards, using sustainable practices that enhance outdoor spaces across Melbourne's west.
servicesText: From routine maintenance to complete garden overhauls, we offer a wide range of services to keep your outdoor space looking its best. Our team is equipped to handle all aspects of gardening with professionalism and care, focusing on the unique needs of Caroline Springs gardens.

services.title: Lawn Mowing & Edging
services.desc: Regular mowing and precise edging to keep your lawn neat and tidy throughout the seasons in Caroline Springs.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weeding, pruning, and general upkeep to ensure your garden thrives year-round with minimal effort on your part.

services.title: Hedge Trimming
services.desc: Expert trimming and shaping of hedges to maintain privacy and aesthetic appeal in your Caroline Springs property.

services.title: Garden Design
services.desc: Custom garden designs that reflect your style and suit the Caroline Springs environment, from concept to completion.

services.title: Planting & Mulching
services.desc: Selection and planting of native and ornamental plants, with mulching to retain soil health and reduce water usage.

services.title: Cleanup Services
services.desc: Thorough garden cleanups including leaf removal and debris disposal for a fresh, welcoming outdoor area.
